CommunityApplications.Profile:
**tofa is a media server for your movies and shows, built for people who own their library.**
One container runs everything: the server, its own database, automatic backups, and its own video engine for hardware transcoding.
- **Point it at your media** and claim the server with your tofa account. - **Watch anywhere** on the web, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android TV, and Windows. - **Runs alongside what you already have** on port 33333.
tofa is in beta. Sign up at [tofa.tv](https://tofa.tv).
